choices.text: Remind me of the three schools.
The shed's gone quiet. Rats are down.

nodes.text: Sword: three cuts, third lands hardest, dash what you can't trade. Bow: full draw or don't bother. Staff: aim, the spark does the rest. That's the drill. Now go use it.

So it HAS gone quiet. Well cut, waker. You opened the chest too, I hope — never leave a chest shut. Here — {item:arrow}, thirty of them. That's as near a medal as this village mints. When Rowan sends you east, you'll do.

Inside the hedgerows, nothing will touch you. Past them it gets braver by the mile — stray wolves first, then camps with watch-fires, and out where the maps give up, _things with names_. The wayfarers' lanterns are the only friendly lights out there. Distance is the only warning the wild gives. Respect it.
Then pass through. Mind the racks.
